newsitem.title: CANADA: Domco sends circular on Armstrong.
newsitem.headline: Domco sends circular on Armstrong.

text.p: Domco Inc. said on Thursday it is sending to its shareholders a directors' circular that has no recommendation on the unsolicited takeover offer from Armstrong World Industries Inc.

In the circular, shareholders are advised that a recommendation, if any, will be made as soon as practicable and, if the expiry date of Armstrong's offer is not extended, the recommendation will come at the latest on July 7.
Farham, Quebec-based Domco will take all appropriate steps, through press releases or otherwise, to disseminate any such recommendation, it said.
The shareholders should read the Directors' circular carefully for more details, Domco said.
Lancaster, Pa.-based Armstrong has bid C$23 a share all of Domco's issued and outstanding securities, including common shares, warrants and debentures.
Sommer Allibert SA, Domco's controlling shareholder, plans to merge its flooring coverage business, which includes Domco, with Tarkett AG. ((Reuters Montreal bureau 514-985-2434))
